notes.title: [Demo] Update: record mode now available!
notes.content:
The restriction has been removed for the record mode. It is now available from the very beginning without having to go through two Flows.

Record your flow by clicking on the big red "rec" button in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37052597/5908e6f25e4ac2c4cae9dcca765a18e4ac282895.png[/img]

notes.title: [Demo] Bug fix: Flow mode now works as intended for a subset of players
notes.content: - If you're one of the players who went into Flow mode only to have the game end right away... PSYCH! That wasn't the actual demo gameplay!! Give the demo a try again as Flow mode will now correctly populate the track.
